section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces body appreciation as a positive body image construct and highlights the study's goal to explore the effect of external shame on body appreciation in a sample of Portuguese young adults, also testing the role of self-compassion. Results indicated that body mass index and external shame were negative correlates, while self-compassion was a positive correlate of body appreciation, with self-compassion mediating the relationship between shame and body appreciation. This paper describes a single study, referred to as 'this study'.
